description: Routine follow-up with improving low back pain and a spoken recap

transcript.speaker: Clinician
transcript.text: How has the low back been this week?

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Better, about a three out of ten. Mornings are stiff.

transcript.speaker: Clinician
transcript.text: Keep up the cat-cow twice a day.

transcript.speaker: Clinician
transcript.text: Recap: L5 left posterior, right SI, diversified. Lumbar flexion improved. Low back three of ten. Continue weekly.

sections.objective: L5 left posterior. Lumbar flexion limited.
